pick.name: Obsidian
pick.what: Local Markdown vault app with plugins, Web Clipper and (since 1.12.4) an official CLI
pick.why: Plain .md files on disk mean Claude Code reads/writes notes with zero glue; official CLI (Feb 2026) adds search/daily-note automation; free for commercial use since Feb 2025
pick.free_limits: App free for all use incl. commercial; Sync $4/mo (annual) and Publish $8/mo optional

alts.name: Notion
alts.what: Cloud docs + databases with an official hosted MCP server
alts.why: Best if you want web-first docs you can share with clients and a hosted MCP (OAuth) that Claude connects to without local files
alts.free_limits: Free: unlimited blocks for solo workspace, 5 MB uploads, 7-day page history, Notion AI only as a limited trial; Plus $10/member/mo

alts.name: Anytype
alts.what: Local-first, end-to-end-encrypted object/graph notes with official MCP server
alts.why: Local-first + E2E sync for free with a real Android app; flips the choice if you want encrypted phone sync without paying Obsidian Sync
alts.free_limits: Free tier exists; exact storage/device limits not readable on pricing page
alts.license: Any Source Available License 1.0 (source-available, not OSI)

candidates.name: Obsidian
candidates.verdict: PICK: files-on-disk is the best Claude Code/MCP surface; free commercial use; huge plugin ecosystem

candidates.name: Notion
candidates.verdict: Wins for shared client-facing docs and hosted MCP; loses on lock-in and offline/local access

candidates.name: Anytype
candidates.verdict: Wins for free encrypted mobile sync; source-available licence and object model are harder for Claude Code to edit directly

candidates.name: Logseq
candidates.verdict: DB version (2.0) only in beta since 2026-07-13 with data-loss warnings; file version in maintenance; wait

candidates.name: AFFiNE
candidates.verdict: Active (canary 2026-10-27) but whiteboard/doc hybrid with less mature plugin/AI-agent story

candidates.name: SiYuan
candidates.verdict: Active (v3.8.9-rc 2026-10-28) but stores blocks in its own format, weaker for direct Claude Code edits

candidates.name: Trilium Notes
candidates.verdict: Active (v0.106.1) but self-host/sync server needed and DB-backed notes

candidates.name: Joplin
candidates.verdict: Active, open source, but Markdown inside its own DB/sync model; smaller plugin ecosystem

decision: Obsidian wins because a folder of Markdown is the lowest-friction thing for Claude Code to read, grep and write, the 1.12.4 official CLI adds app-aware automation, and it costs $0 for commercial use. For phone sync at $0, use a private Git repo on your machine plus Syncthing-Fork (researchxxl, v2.1.7.0 2026-10-21) on Android; pay Obsidian Sync ($4/mo) when mobile editing becomes daily. Switch to Notion only if notes must be shared live with clients.
details: Keep the vault in a personal folder (not the company OneDrive). obsidian-git author says mobile Git is 'very unstable'; use it on desktop only.

verify.note: Licence page: 'free for all purposes, including personal, commercial, and non-profit use', last updated 2025-02-20. Official Obsidian CLI introduced in Desktop v1.12.4 (changelog 2026-02-27); v1.12.7 (2026-03-23) added a dedicated CLI binary.
